symptoms: Dark brown to black water-soaked lesions on leaves and stems, with white mildew growth on underside in damp conditions.
causes: Cool, wet humid weather (humidity >85%, temp 15-22°C). Spores travel via wind & rain splash.
organic_treatment: Foliar spray of Copper Octanoate or Trichoderma viride bio-fungicide every 7 days. Prune infected stems immediately and burn.
regenerative_prevention: Plant certified blight-resistant varieties (e.g. Kufri Girdhari). Maintain wide plant spacing for airflow and mulch with straw.

symptoms: Yellowish-orange pustules arranged in distinct stripes parallel to leaf veins.
causes: Cool temperatures (10-15°C) and high dew formation.
organic_treatment: Foliar spray of Neem leaf extract (5%) mixed with Pseudomonas fluorescens bio-agent. Dust soil with bio-sulfur.
regenerative_prevention: Adopt intercropping with leguminous crops (Chickpea/Fava Bean) to break fungal spore corridors across fields.
brics_impact_zone: India (NW Plain Zone), China (Yellow River Basin), South Africa (Western Cape)

symptoms: Oval to elongate reddish-brown pustules scattered across both upper and lower leaf surfaces.
causes: High humidity and warm days combined with cool nights.
organic_treatment: Bio-fungicide application of Bacillus subtilis. Spray fermented butter-milk solution mixed with copper sulfate.
regenerative_prevention: Ensure crop rotation with non-cereal legumes (Soybean / Cowpea). Avoid over-application of synthetic nitrogen.
brics_impact_zone: Brazil (Mato Grosso), South Africa (Free State), China (Black Soil)

symptoms: Upward curling and yellowing of leaf margins, stunted plant growth, aborted flower buds.
causes: Vectored by Whitefly (Bemisia tabaci) during dry hot spells.
organic_treatment: Yellow sticky traps (25 traps/ha). Spray bio-pesticide made from Neem oil (10,000 ppm) + garlic-chili extract.
regenerative_prevention: Plant border crops of Maize or Sorghum as natural windbreaks to block vector whiteflies. Intercrop with Marigold.

symptoms: Water-soaked wavy streaks along leaf margins that turn yellow-orange and dry up into straw-colored stripes.
causes: High temperatures (28-34°C), heavy rainstorms, and excess standing water.
organic_treatment: Drain standing water for 3 days. Apply fresh cow-dung filtrate (2%) mixed with copper oxychloride.
regenerative_prevention: Practice System of Rice Intensification (SRI) with dry-seeding and alternate wetting/drying to reduce anaerobic bacterial proliferation.

symptoms: Olive-green velvety spots on leaves that turn dark brown and scabby on fruit.
causes: High rainfall during spring bud break and cool damp nights.
organic_treatment: Apply sulfur dust or liquid lime-sulfur bio-fungicide during early leaf expansion.
regenerative_prevention: Prune canopy to promote air circulation and destroy fallen leaf litter in autumn.

symptoms: Small reddish-brown spots on leaves that expand with dark margins; fruit shrivels into black mummies.
causes: Warm, wet weather during early vine shoot emergence.
organic_treatment: Spray Trichoderma harzianum or copper hydroxide bio-agent at 10-day intervals.
regenerative_prevention: Remove and burn all mummified fruit clusters during winter pruning.

symptoms: Raised corky brown lesions surrounded by a yellow halo on leaves, twigs, and fruit.
causes: Wind-driven rainfall and citrus leafminer insect feeding damage.
organic_treatment: Spray copper sulfate combined with neem oil extract. Quarantine infected saplings.
regenerative_prevention: Plant windbreaks around orchards to reduce wind-blown rain droplet vectoring.

symptoms: Angular dark brown lesions bounded by leaf veins; boll rot under humid conditions.
causes: High atmospheric humidity and contaminated seed stock.
organic_treatment: Seed treatment with Pseudomonas fluorescens bio-agent. Foliar spray of streptomycin sulfate + copper.
regenerative_prevention: Use acid-delinted resistant seed varieties. Rotate with non-host leguminous cover crops.

symptoms: Tiny tan-to-reddish brown pustules on lower leaf surfaces causing premature defoliation.
causes: Spore blown from overwintering leguminous weeds during moist summer winds.
organic_treatment: Foliar bio-agent spray of Bacillus amyloliquefaciens combined with mineral oil.
regenerative_prevention: Early planting of early-maturing cultivars. Intercrop with Safrinha Maize.
